title: CoVeR: Coverage-Based Token Pruning for Multi-View 3D Reasoning in VLMs
abstract: arXiv:2609.08345v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Representing a 3D scene as multi-view images allows 2D VLMs to reason in 3D by reusing priors from pre-training, sidestepping the scarcity of annotated 3D data. However, it produces thousands of redundant visual tokens whose cost grows with every view. Existing visual token pruners fall into two families, each limited in the 3D multi-view setting. Learned importance methods rank tokens by attention or encoder features; because redundancy here is fundamentally spatial, they keep near-duplicate tokens from a few prominent regions and leave most of the scene unrepresented. Voxelization methods improve spatial coverage but cannot enforce an exact token budget and saturate as multi-view observations overlap in 3D, capping retention well below the target. We show that spatial coverage is associated with 3D reasoning performance and introduce CoVeR, a deterministic, training-free selector that uses only token coordinates, with no learned sign

translated_title: CoVeR：面向视觉语言模型多视角3D推理的基于覆盖度的Token剪枝方法
translated_abstract: 将3D场景表示为多视角图像，可以让2D视觉语言模型通过复用预训练先验来进行3D推理，从而规避标注3D数据稀缺的问题。然而，这种方式会产生数千个冗余的视觉token，其成本随视角数量不断增长。现有的视觉token剪枝方法分为两类，在3D多视角场景下各有局限。基于学习的重要性方法通过注意力或编码器特征对token进行排序；由于这类场景中的冗余本质上是空间性的，这些方法会保留来自少数显著区域的近似重复token，导致场景的大部分区域未被表示。体素化方法虽改善了空间覆盖度，但无法强制执行精确的token预算，且随着多视角观测在3D空间中重叠而饱和，使保留率远低于目标。我们证明了空间覆盖度与3D推理性能相关，并提出了CoVeR，一种确定性的、无需训练的选择器，仅使用token坐标，无需任何学习信号。
tldr: 提出CoVeR，一种无需训练、仅依据token坐标的空间覆盖度进行确定性视觉token剪枝的方法，解决多视角3D推理中冗余token过多及现有剪枝方法覆盖不足的问题。
en_tdlr: CoVeR is a deterministic, training-free visual token pruning method that selects tokens solely based on coordinate spatial coverage, enabling efficient multi-view 3D reasoning in VLMs.
